# Pancake (dark): a 12-sided disc 0.54 across, 0.03 thick (it bakes ~0.1 thick: a disc spreads
# past its faces), origin at its centre so it flips about it. Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Top --base-color 0.8706 0.6392 0.5451 --no-slot
material new Edge --base-color 0.4235 0.3373 0.4431 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Pancake --vertices 12 --radius 0.27 --depth 0.03 --location 0 0 0
material assign Edge
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
material assign Top
mode object
shade flat
export pancake_dark.glb
